punchline: Bill Gates is an introvert who isn't shy and Barbra Streisand is shy but outgoing, so quiet and afraid are two different things.
thirty_sec: A Harvard psychologist, Jerome Kagan, tested about 500 four-month-olds with popping balloons and alcohol swabs. Some babies flailed and cried, some stayed calm. He predicted the criers would turn out quiet and checked at two, four, seven and eleven with a clown and a gas mask. Most matched. Susan Cain uses it to separate fear of people from a low tolerance for noise.
